skins.title: Seia bar (shadow)
skins.author: weejiaquan
skins.description: A wide illustrated plate with the bar recessed into the artwork: the lit pixels live between x=325 and x=1182, so full.png paints only the bar and every bit of decoration sits in empty.png. The percent number is centre-anchored over the right-hand card in the skin's own gold, with a warm sand outline so it stays readable over both the lit and unlit bar.
skins.credit: Artwork by the AorinEQ author, published here as the reference skin.
